GameDay TV 2.4 redesigns On Demand like Nuvio, with trailer previews, gives movies and shows a Nuvio-style player, and adds LIVE and catch-up buttons to live TV. The Home tab is gone.

**On Demand**
- The highlighted title fills the top of the screen: backdrop, logo, IMDb rating, year, genres and description
- Rest on a poster and it widens to play the trailer; title pages play it behind the details (Settings › Playback › Trailer previews: muted, with sound or off)
- Continue watching, Your list, add-on catalogs, and your provider's movies and shows, all in one place

**Movies and shows**
- New player: title and episode, full-width progress bar (hold ◀ ▶ to scrub faster), clock and "Ends at"
- Buttons for next episode, subtitles, audio, sources (switch source without losing your place), episodes, speed and picture size

**Live TV**
- LIVE button: red when you're live, grey when you're behind; press it to jump back to live
- Catch-up: start the current program over or replay earlier ones on channels with catch-up
- YouTube TV-style back 10 / forward 30 buttons, which also work on live streams that can be rewound

**More**
- No more Home tab: the app opens on Sports, which now has the Multiview row and provider setup

**Upgrading:** install over 2.3 with Downloader code `3558070`. Your account, provider and settings carry over.
